sft.source: 240 actual teacher research trajectories on train tasks only

rloo.group_context: same train task instance, initial state and study budget
rloo.simulation_seeds: common random-number streams per experiment signature where applicable
rloo.old_policy: frozen for the entire four-trajectory group
rloo.reference_policy: frozen SFT adapter on the same Qwen3.5-9B weights
rloo.estimator: initial-state trajectory LOO with multi-turn evidence attribution and explicit component masks
rloo.trajectory_advantage: A_i = R_i - sum(R_j for j != i)/(G-1)
rloo.process_rewards: deduplicated verified evidence increments, falsification, discriminating experiments and attributable allocation quality
rloo.terminal_reward: evidence-based final scientific validity and supported predictions, including partial conclusions
rloo.positive_credit: attach each evidence increment to the executed student-sourced decision components and their causal ancestors
rloo.full_host_takeover: zero student positive credit; keep audit and failure/accounting record
rloo.component_masks: record masked contribution as a conservative attribution surrogate, not an unbiased counterfactual causal estimator
rloo.resume: restore policy, optimizer, RNG, sampler, immutable group records and development selection state

rollout_correction.method: tokenwise truncated importance correction in the RLOO actor loss

rewards.fabricated_receipt: reject evidence and apply penalty; retain run for C and D

runtime_validation.short_sampling_replay: measured numerical mismatch up to 0.07808 in four-token log probability; corrected using explicit IS in trainer
